description: This file defines utility methods for parsing Java source files within the OFBiz framework, including locating class files, identifying method blocks, finding service and entity calls within code blocks, and stripping comments. It appears to be primarily used for analyzing Java source code relevant to OFBiz's internal utilities.

classes.name: UtilJavaParse
classes.description: Utility class providing source code analysis functionalities such as locating source files, parsing method blocks, analyzing service and entity method calls, and removing comments from Java source files.

methods.name: findRealPathAndFileForClass
methods.description: Locates the source file path for a given fully qualified class name across all component source directories.

methods.name: findServiceMethodBlockStart
methods.description: Finds the starting position of a service method block by searching for method signature patterns within Java source code.

methods.name: findEndOfBlock
methods.description: Recursively finds the closing brace position for a code block starting at a given position.

methods.name: findServiceCallsInBlock
methods.description: Extracts service call names within a specified code block by analyzing dispatcher calls.

methods.name: findEntityUseInBlock
methods.description: Extracts entity-related method call names within a specified code block by analyzing delegator calls.

methods.name: stripComments
methods.description: Removes block comments and line comments from Java source code to facilitate parsing.
